outputs.explanation: Spatial deconvolution plots display per-spot values as a heatmap over the tissue image; each spot is already an individual data point, so overlaying additional individual data points is not applicable.

Box plots of immune cell fractions have individual data points (colored dots for each biological replicate) overlaid on the boxes, in addition to being a distribution-showing plot type that is inherently exempt.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots; overlaying individual data points on this plot type is not applicable/would not be meaningful.

Bar graph shows a single computed statistic (log2 fold change from DEG analysis) per gene rather than an average of individual replicate measurements, so there are no underlying individual data points to overlay.
Panel E consists of H&E and IHC micrographs, not a plot of averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
